import json, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
positive = ['tools/dev-preview/authorize.mjs', 'tools/dev-preview/preview.mjs', 'tools/dev-preview/authorize.test.mjs', '.github/workflows/deploy_preview.yaml', '.github/workflows/deploy_dev_database.yaml', '.github/workflows/dev_preview_ci.yaml', 'apps/web/cloudflare.config.ts', 'docs/development-preview.md']
negative = ['.github/workflows/deploy_production.yaml', 'tools/unrelated/example.mjs', 'apps/web/src/main.tsx']
for path in positive + negative:
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', suffix='.json') as f:
        json.dump([path], f); f.flush()
        rules = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['/tmp/aidd-v4', '--root', '.', 'rules', '--paths', f.name]))
    ids = {r['id'] for r in rules}
    assert ('infrastructure.dev-preview' in ids) == (path in positive), (path, ids)
    if path in positive:
        assert {'infrastructure.overview', 'documentation.policy', 'architecture.overview'} <= ids, (path, ids)
print('8 target paths and 3 unrelated paths: routing and dependency closure passed')
